program:
app "Times tables" calc mint
table attempt ok bool
state a num = 3
state b num = 4
state ans num = 0
"What is" a "x" b "?" big
field ans "Your answer"
button "Check" tap add attempt ok = if(ans = a * b, yes, no) then set a = random(12) then set b = random(12) then set ans = 0
if count(attempt) > 0
  if(last(attempt.ok), "Last one: right", "Last one: try again") faint
count(attempt where ok = yes) "right of" count(attempt) big
describe:
Times tables, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- attempt: ok: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: a, starting at 3; b, starting at 4; ans, starting at 0.
Shows:
- text: "What is", a, "x", b, "?".
- a box to fill in ans, labelled "Your answer".
- a button "Check"; a tap adds a attempt with ok set to yes when ans is a times b, otherwise no, then sets a to a random whole number from 1 to 12, then sets b to a random whole number from 1 to 12, then sets ans to 0.
- if how many attempt entries is more than 0:
  - text: "Last one: right" when the latest ok of attempt, otherwise "Last one: try again".
- text: how many attempt entries where ok is yes, "right of", how many attempt entries.

program:
app "Zakat and tip" calc ocean
setting cash money = 0 "Cash and bank"
setting gold num = 0 "Gold (grams)"
setting silver num = 0 "Silver (grams)"
setting gold_rate money = 0 "Gold price per gram"
setting silver_rate money = 0 "Silver price per gram"
setting debts money = 0 "Debts due now"
state bill money = 0
state tip num = 10
state people num = 1
let wealth = cash + gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate - debts
let nisab = 612.36 * silver_rate
screen zakat "Zakat" coin
  field cash
  field gold
  field silver
  field gold_rate
  field silver_rate
  field debts
  if(wealth >= nisab, "Zakat due (2.5%)", "Below nisab: no zakat due") faint
  round(if(wealth >= nisab, wealth * 0.025, 0)) big
screen split "Tip" calc
  field bill "Bill"
  "Tip" tip "%" faint
  slider tip 0..30
  "People" people faint
  slider people 1..20
  "Tip" round(bill * tip / 100) head
  "Each pays" round(bill * (1 + tip / 100) / people) big
describe:
Zakat and tip, in the ocean colours.
You can change: "Cash and bank": money, starts at 0; "Gold (grams)": number, starts at 0; "Silver (grams)": number, starts at 0; "Gold price per gram": money, starts at 0; "Silver price per gram": money, starts at 0; "Debts due now": money, starts at 0.
Works out:
- wealth is cash plus gold times gold rate plus silver times silver rate minus debts.
- nisab is 612.36 times silver rate.
Remembers while you use it: bill, starting at 0; tip, starting at 10; people, starting at 1.
Shows:
- a screen "Zakat":
  - a box to fill in cash.
  - a box to fill in gold.
  - a box to fill in silver.
  - a box to fill in gold rate.
  - a box to fill in silver rate.
  - a box to fill in debts.
  - text: "Zakat due (2.5%)" when wealth is at least nisab, otherwise "Below nisab: no zakat due".
  - text: wealth times 0.025 when wealth is at least nisab, otherwise 0 rounded.
- a screen "Tip":
  - a box to fill in bill, labelled "Bill".
  - text: "Tip", tip, "%".
  - a slider for tip from 0 to 30.
  - text: "People", people.
  - a slider for people from 1 to 20.
  - text: "Tip", bill times tip divided by 100 rounded.
  - text: "Each pays", bill times the result of 1 plus tip divided by 100 divided by people rounded.
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
order: start with the numbers or units

program:
app "Journal" book slate
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
"How are you feeling?" head
row gap 1
  each ["Awful", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great"]
    stack grow align center tap set d.mood = index + 1
      draw width 44
        circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft)
        rect 30, 74 - 12 * index, 40, 8 + 12 * index fill bg radius 3
      it tiny
field d.note "What is on your mind?"
button "Save entry" tap save d
row gap 2
  stat streak(entry), if(count(entry today) > 0, "day streak, including today", "day streak; write today to keep it")
  stat count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0), "of 14 days written"
row gap 1
  each days last 14 days
    box grow height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(entry on it) > 0, accent, soft)
"Mood this week" round(avg(entry.mood week)) "vs" round(avg(entry.mood prev week)) "last week" faint
trend entry last 30 days sort at, it.mood
state q text = ""
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
list entry where has(note, q) by day
"Saved on this device only." faint
describe:
Journal, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- entry: mood: number, 1 to 5; note: long text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: d, a new entry being filled in; q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: "How are you feeling?".
- for "Awful", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great":
  - a group; a tap sets the mood of the d to its position plus 1:
    - a drawing made of circles, rectangles.
    - text: the value.
- a box to fill in the note of the d, labelled "What is on your mind?".
- a button "Save entry"; a tap saves the new d.
- a big number: the current day streak of entry entries, labelled "day streak, including today" when how many entry entries today is more than 0, otherwise "day streak; write today to keep it".
- a big number: how many of the day in the last 14 days have how many entry entries on that day is more than 0, labelled "of 14 days written".
- for each day in the last 14 days:
- text: "Mood this week", the average mood of entry this week rounded, "vs", the average mood of entry last week rounded, "last week".
- a line chart of its mood over entry in the last 30 days sorted by at.
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search entries".
- if q is not "" and how many entry entries where note contains q is 0:
  - text: "Nothing found. Try a shorter word.".
- a list of entry where note contains q by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
- text: "Saved on this device only.".

fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
